NetBoxTokenCredential.title: Netbox API Token
NetBoxTokenCredential.x-credential-instructions: Enter your public HTTPS NetBox origin and paste an API token from your user profile. Prefer a v2 token (nbt_<key>.<token>); legacy v1 tokens are also supported. Enable writes and grant the relevant object permissions for write operations. Triggers also need add/delete permissions for extras.webhook and extras.eventrule. Private network instances cannot be reached from NoClick.
